email.subject1: a signal play for your dealer network
email.body1:
Russ, saw Wavetronix unifying its sensor line under Expanse and pushing the European dealer partner operation.

Scaling a dealer ecosystem usually means more partner-sourced opportunities than the team can co-sell into before they go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up across the partner ecosystem with zero rep time, so co-sell coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for your dealer partners off their hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Russ, quick follow-up on the dealer partner side.

As the European network grows, partner-sourced pipeline usually outpaces the team's capacity to co-sell it. Most teams don't know how many co-sell meetings they need to cover the ecosystem, so the gap surfaces late and good partner deals stall.

Want 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a co-sell pilot playbook and our pipeline model, so you can see exactly how many meetings the partner motion needs this quarter.
email.body3:
Russ, last bit of proof.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to your top partner targets. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through them?
email.body4:
Russ, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling partner-sourced pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority right now, no problem at all. Building out a European dealer network is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a co-sell motion? I'll tailor it to your dealer ecosystem either way.
